title: L3Cube-IndicNews: News-based Short Text and Long Document Classification Datasets in Indic Languages
reasoning: The paper introduces and benchmarks new datasets and models for news article classification in Indic languages. While some of the defined news categories in the dataset include 'Bhakti' (for Marathi) and 'Religious' (for Punjabi), the paper focuses on the classification task itself, not on evaluating or benchmarking models for their understanding, representation, or ethical implications regarding faith, morals, or ethics.
